name: Rubescent-Terminus
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an orbital debris ring. Beyond towering mountain ranges, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

The air carries wet iron and lichen, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Something scrubbed this biosphere clean within a geological instant. The rocks remember it as a thin black line.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
